annotations.title: Meeting Slot Finder Across Time Zones

description: Find the meeting times that suit everyone. Send a date range (up to 31 days), the meeting length and, for each attendee (up to 20), their IANA time zone, working hours and working days (default Monday to Friday 09:00-17:00 in their own zone), their busy blocks (clock times in their zone, or UTC instants as calendars export them) and days off. Get back the common free windows, the meeting start times on a step grid (e.g. every 30 minutes) with each attendee's local time, how much working time and free time each attendee has, and, when nothing fits, why: working hours never overlap, the overlap is shorter than the meeting, or busy blocks fill it. Daylight-saving changes inside the range are handled through the IANA time zone database. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/meeting-slot-finder). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

days_off.description: Days off or holidays in their zone, YYYY-MM-DD (up to 60).

label.description: Optional role or code, e.g. 'host' or 'London team' (your own text, echoed; not a person's name or email).

work_days.description: Working days (default MO TU WE TH FR).

items.description: MO TU WE TH FR SA SU.

work_end.description: Working hours end in their zone, HH:MM (default 17:00).

work_start.description: Working hours start in their zone, HH:MM (default 09:00).

zone.description: Attendee's IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/London.

end_date.description: Last day to search (included), YYYY-MM-DD, in search_zone; at most 31 days after start_date counting both.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'quarterly review' (your own text, echoed).

max_results.description: How many start times to list, earliest first (1 to 50; all are counted).

search_zone.description: IANA zone the date range and the start-time grid are read in (default: the first attendee's zone).

start_date.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD, in search_zone.

step_minutes.description: Start times are on this grid of search_zone clock time (default 30: :00 and :30).
